sections.reference_sahasrayogam_taila_yoga_prakar: Asana Vilwadi Thailam (Oil) is also known as Asana Vilwadi Tailam. It an Ayurvedic oil used in the treatment of diseases related eyes, ear and headache.
sections.ingredients:

sections.how_to_use:
This oil is meant to be used for external application only.

sections.indications:

 Tinnitus 
 Earache 
 Eye pain and minor eye infection 
 Headache 
 Dizziness
sections.side_effects:
There are no side effects with this oil on external application. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Asana Vilwadi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Taila Yoga Prakarana 45 
 Asana Vilwadi Thailam (Oil) is also known as Asana Vilwadi Tailam. It an Ayurvedic oil used in the treatment of diseases related eyes, ear and headache. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Asana – Pterocarpus marsupium 
 Vilwa – Aegle marmelos 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Amruta – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Madhuka – Licorice – Glycyrhiza glabra 
 Nagara – Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Triphala – Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica, Emblica officinalis 
 Cow Milk 
 Taila – Sesame oil or coconut oil 
 
 How to use? 
 
 This oil is meant to be used for external application only. 
 It is used to apply overhead and in Ayurvedic procedures such as Dhara, karna poorana (instillation into ear), Tarpana (for eyes) etc. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Hearing difficulties 
 Tinnitus 
 Earache 
 Eye pain and minor eye infection 
 Headache 
 Dizziness 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no side effects with this oil on external application. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
